summary: Now live on Google Play (com.nutrisize.pro) as of Apr 13, 2026. NutriGuide on-device AI chat, health history snapshots, smart provider recommendations, and production polish across all platforms. iOS v1.0.0 build 4 submitted to App Store.
included: Published on Google Play Store (com.nutrisize.pro) — live in Production since Apr 13, 2026
NutriGuide: On-device conversational AI for nutrition, exercise, and health questions with voice input (iOS Speech, Android SpeechRecognizer, Web Speech API)
NutriGuide: Smart keyword extraction, intent detection, and contextual responses from 10,000+ database entries
NutriGuide: In-app browser for external AI references (Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity) with Close/Reload/Open in Browser
NutriGuide: Chat persistence across navigation, with clear history option in Data Management
Health History: Auto-snapshot from Basic Health Parameters with timestamps for timeseries analysis
Health History: Dynamic weight range based on user height (BMI 18.5-24.9)
Health History: Auto-populated parameters (weight, BMI, heart rate) hidden from manual entry
Health History: Input validation with medical ranges across all parameters
MDConnect: Smart provider recommendations based on health data (BMI, heart rate, BP, glucose, weight)
MDConnect: Export Health Summary, Share Health Data, Quick Share implemented on iOS (parity with Android)
MDConnect: Fixed storage key mismatches and timestamp formatting across platforms
Paywall: Billing fallback with approximate pricing, discount hints, and contextual status messages
Paywall: StoreKit configuration with all 4 products for iOS sandbox testing
Renamed NutriSize to Nutrisize across all user-visible strings
Keyboard dismiss on tap outside in Basic Health Parameters and NutriGuide chat
iOS: Diagnostics and Database Explorer routes wired up (was Coming Soon)
23/23 feature parity between iOS and Android

summary: First stable release of Nutrisize Pro — the comprehensive health intelligence platform with 5,000+ foods, 5,400+ exercises, 201 physiological parameters, and personalized wellness plans.
included: 5,006 world foods in SQLite database with nutrition data from USDA, WHO, and regional authorities
5,404 exercises across 6 categories: Strength, Cardio, Flexibility, Rehabilitation, Military (Navy SEAL/Army/Marines/AF), Balance
201 physiological parameters across 16 body systems with physician-grade content
75 nutrients (33 macro + 42 micro) with daily values for 16 demographics
Personalized weekly meal plans (Individualized Nutrition)
4-product in-app purchase system: Physiology, Nutrition, Exercise, and Premium Bundle
Exercise Browser with search, category filters, and calorie burn scoring
Food Browser with 23 food categories and nutrient density scores
10-language Physiology translations (English, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Arabic, French, Portuguese, Bengali, Japanese, Nepali)
Translate-any-text feature using on-device ML (iOS: Apple Translation, Android: ML Kit)
Cross-linking between Nutrition, Exercise, and Physiology for holistic health understanding
Military fitness: All US branch PT standards, Navy SEAL BUD/S training, Ranger, Green Beret, MARSOC
Age-specific programs from toddler (2-5) to elderly (80+)
Occupation-specific exercise: firefighter, police, farming, office, healthcare
Climate-adapted training: hot, cold, altitude, mountain, tropical
Diagnostics page with database size tracking and app resource monitoring
Privacy-first, local-first architecture — all data stored on device
Dark theme UI across all platforms
